verdicts.why: On screen in The Punisher S2 Amy says 'I work... worked for Fiona... Someone killed them all. I'm the only one left' (episode 1) and 'I worked for her. Me and the others. She took care of us, and we did jobs for her' (episode 4); Pilgrim killed the whole crew before the series opens, so the group ends. The screen names no group, so 'Fiona's Crew' is a plain descriptive label like 'Kid Loki's Crew' (owner's open question on labelling unnamed crews still applies); add left 'The Punisher S2'.

The past service is told on screen, but the branch is named: in episode 2 Matt tells the court 'Mr. Ayala is a decorated Army veteran. He has no record. He served as a CPA for 15 years.' So use the dataset's 'U.S. Army', not 'U.S. Military'; he is a civilian in the show, so add left 'Daredevil: Born Again S1'.

Told on screen: Karli worked as the Power Broker's muscle after taking the serum (episode 3), and in episode 6 tells Sharon 'You just want me because you need your muscle back. Without us super soldiers, how much power does the Power Broker really have?' after Sharon says Karli left and betrayed her. 'The Power Broker' is the dataset's existing name; she deserted to lead the Flag Smashers, so no left is needed.

This is the owner's settled call (morning_calls settled: 'John Walker: O.X.E. Group from The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (episode 6, when Valentina makes him U.S. Agent), after his U.S. Army discharge'). The Independent stage and left for the gap between his episode 5 discharge and Valentina's recruitment are consistent with Yelena's record.

In the Black Widow post-credits scene Yelena is already Valentina's operative ('You're not supposed to be bothering me on my holiday time, Valentina', asks for a raise, gets her next assignment), and she keeps working for her until Thunderbolts*, where it is O.X.E. ('complete this last assignment for O.X.E.'). The same treatment the owner ruled for Walker; 'Black Widow (Post-Credits Scene)' is a title her record already uses.

The past coven and her turning on it are shown (WandaVision episode 8: 'Yet you have betrayed your coven', she kills them all and leaves), but the screen does name it: in Agatha All Along episode 5 her mother's ghost says 'Evanora Harkness of the Salemites... My coven risked everything to kill her.' Use 'The Salemites', not the invented 'Evanora's coven'; left 'WandaVision'. (A:agatha-harkness should carry the same past stage, keyed to its own first title.)

The Punisher S1 episode 3 flashback shows Major Schoonover co-founding and commanding the Cerberus Squad with Rawlins ('This is Operation Cerberus and you are my dogs of war'); the squad ends after Kandahar and he stays a Marine colonel into Daredevil S2. The person who runs a crew is in it, and the shape matches Rawlins (CIA, Cerberus Squad, CIA).

Confirmed on screen in Luke Cage S2 episode 1: 'He used to run this crew called the Rivals.' 'Nah, he wasn't no Rival. That was Shades, Comanche, and Romeo's old crew', and Shades greets Comanche with 'Rivals? We ain't got none.' But a past group is keyed to the person's first title (owner's rule), so the stage is 'Luke Cage S1', not S2. (Comanche's record would take the same past stage.)

The past membership and his leaving it are shown (S2 episode 9: Kusack's men, 'the man I knew left 12 years ago to make a buy... along with our money', 'a true believer in what we stood for', 'the price for betrayal'), but no name is said: neither 'Aryan Brotherhood' nor 'the Aryans' is in the season's dialogue, and an Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. name for a different gang doesn't carry over. With no name on screen and none in the dataset, this is an owner call (label it, e.g. as Kusack's gang, or leave it out), not a record change.

The screen doesn't clearly show service in a Chicago force: in episode 6 Fisk says 'Born and raised in Chicago, top of your class in the Academy, made Detective in only three years... Yet here you are in New York', and North tells of a captain who disapproved, but no Chicago police is named or placed. The MCU Wiki's own dates from the file shown on screen put his move to the NYPD in 2011 and his promotion to detective 3 years later, in the NYPD. 'Chicago Police Department' is a wiki label, and an unsure case keeps what's there.

In the S2 finale Buck takes Dex's bullet meant for Fisk and his fate is left unclear; he never quits or is fired, and Fisk's own record keeps Fisk's Empire after he takes the exile deal. Being shot is not a departure (and the left had no Independent stage to match), so remove left 'Daredevil: Born Again S2'.

The only source is Bobbi's psych profile in S2 'The Things We Bury' ('probably Southall... military straightened him out till they sensed something off and washed him out. Ended up a private intelligence contractor'), and she says only 'that last part I checked on', so the military past is her guess. The screen also says only 'military': 'British Army' is a branch inferred from his accent. An unsure, unnamed case keeps what's there.

Undercover service inside the ATCU for HYDRA is shown and told: in S3 'Many Heads, One Tale' he works at Endotex Labs alongside Luther Banks guarding HYDRA's hand in the ATCU, and in S3 'Paradise Lost' Coulson says 'Before the ATCU, Giyera spent years in special ops.' Undercover service counts; 'The ATCU' is the dataset's name.

Told on screen in S3 'Paradise Lost': Daisy calls James 'another Afterlife Inhuman', and Lincoln says 'Few weeks after I got there, Jiaying caught him breaking into her private archives and banished him'; James expected 'Jiaying to send out one of her little lapdogs'. Banishment is a departure, so Afterlife then Independent in S3, then the Watchdogs in S4 (the Hive question stays a separate owner call).

Shown and named on screen in S4 'The Man Behind the Shield': flashbacks show his unit of 'SVR agents' at the mining facility, Daisy says 'Ivanov mentioned his SVR unit being tortured and executed', and Coulson tells him 'You were one of the SVR agents... That was your unit.' 'Da.' A past group shown on screen, before the Watchdogs.

The ring is shown (S2 'B Sides': Lia works for Andre, and they deliver Tandy to the Viking Motel), and 'Andre's trafficking ring' is the dataset's existing name in the pr circles (it is still in the owner's open question on unnamed crews). But it ends on screen: Tandy and Tyrone fight through the motel ('Vikingtown Sound'), then Andre and Lia skip town and he drains and abandons her ('Two Player'). So add Independent and left 'Cloak & Dagger', and key the first stage to 'Cloak & Dagger' since '(from the start)' is only for a single-group record. (His old jazz band at Club Delight is unnamed: an owner call if wanted.)

Story order: he is the Kingpin's hired muscle in The Alien Costume (his episode 10 step), the Kingpin breaks him out into the Insidious Six (S2 episodes 1 and 2), and 'the Six's defeat led to their disbandment', until the Kingpin rallies them again in Six Forgotten Warriors (S5 episodes 2 to 6), after which the team is defunct. This follows the owner's settled call (Fisk's Empire first, drop the middle Fisk stage). The repeated Six stays because the disbandment comes between.
